title: Build a tiny CPU
spec: Accumulator starts at zero. LOAD, ADD and SUB wrap modulo 256. OUT appends a number. HALT stops. Unknown instructions throw.

title: Build an expiring key-value store
description: Implement SET, GET and lazy expiration.
spec: Inject now() in milliseconds. set(key,value,ttl=null) replaces a key; null TTL never expires. A key expires when now >= deadline. Missing or expired get returns null. Negative TTL throws. delete returns whether a key existed.
hints: Store a deadline with each value.

description: Parse a bounded HTTP/1.1 request head.
spec: Input ends its header section with CRLF CRLF. Return {method,path,headers}. Accept uppercase methods and HTTP/1.1 only. Lowercase header names; trim values. Reject duplicate headers, invalid lines and incomplete heads. Body decoding is outside this exercise.

title: Build a DNS cache
spec: put(name,ip,ttl) stores an address until now()+ttl milliseconds. DNS names are case insensitive and may have one trailing dot. Expire at >= deadline. Missing names return null; negative TTL throws. No external network requests.
hints: Normalize both write and lookup keys.

title: Build an inverted index
description: Find documents containing every query term.
spec: Tokenize using lowercase ASCII alphanumeric runs. Build word-to-document-id sets. search(query) returns sorted numeric ids matching every term. Empty queries return []. Repeated words must not duplicate results.
hints: Map each word to a Set of document ids.
Intersect candidate sets for multiword queries.

title: Build a perceptron
description: Implement prediction and one training update.
spec: predict returns 1 if dot(weights,input)+bias >= 0, otherwise 0. Dimensions must match. train returns fresh {weights,bias} using rate*(target-prediction) and does not mutate weights. This is a perceptron exercise, not an LLM.
hints: Compute a weighted sum plus bias.
Use the same prediction threshold when calculating error.
